roadmap.product.name: Roadmap
roadmap.root.line: Tell an AI your goal, get a skill tree.
roadmap.root.title: Tell an AI your goal. {break}Get a skill tree.
roadmap.root.paragraph: Describe what you want to learn or build. Your own assistant, connected to your Windmill account, writes the plan as a tree of steps. You edit it, and you do the steps.
roadmap.root.unlockTitle: Finish a step, the next unlocks
roadmap.root.unlockText: Steps have real prerequisites, so the tree shows what you can work on now.
roadmap.root.noAccountText: Pick a ready path or paste a list. Your first tree lives in your browser.
roadmap.root.shareText: Publish a tree with one link. Anyone can copy it and make it theirs.
roadmap.root.requestText: Plan how I learn to sail
roadmap.quests.attribution: Three of the dev paths adapted from the roadmap.sh community maps (CC BY-SA).

roadmap.landingHead.title: Skill Tree Maker for Real-Life Goals | Windmill Roadmap
roadmap.landingHead.description: Turn a goal or a learning plan into a skill tree. Each step unlocks when its prerequisites are done. Start in your browser, no account needed.
